summary.text: Joe McAndrew is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 32 who has served since February 21, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
McAndrew previously worked in consulting and account management.

paragraphs.text: Joe McAndrew's career experience includes working as a partner with Onpoint Operations & Consulting, an account executive with Sparq Designs, and a senior account manager with Avanti Consulting Group.
McAndrew assumed office on February 21, 2023, succeeding Anthony DeLuca.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Children and Youth, Gaming Oversight, Liquor Control and Transportation committees.
